*Source: [The City of 7 Seraphs](https://www.drivethrurpg.com/product/269801/The-City-of-7-Seraphs?affiliate_id=549120)*

**Skilled Interrogator:** A mindbreaker gains a bonus equal to 1/2 his mesmerist level (minimum 1) on Intimidate checks. Even if a mindbreaker fails an Intimidate check made against a single target by 5 or more, the target will not attempt to deceive the mindbreaker or hinder his actions.

This ability replaces consummate liar.

**Hypnotic Stare (Su):** The penalty for a mindbreaker’s hypnotic stare ability gives a -3 penalty on Will saving throws. This penalty changes to -4 at 8th level and -5 at 15th level.

This ability alters hypnotic stare and replaces the 15th level bold stare.

**Urge to Destruction (Su):** A mindbreaker can bring forth entropy inherent in inanimate objects with a touch. By touching an object as a standard action and expending one use of his mesmerist tricks class feature, the mesmerist lowers the Break DC of the object by an amount equal to his mesmerist level (to a minimum of 0) for 1 minute. The mindbreaker must have the mesmerist tricks class feature to use this ability.

At 14th level, the mesmerist may also reduce the object’s hardness by half his mesmerist level (to a minimum of 0).

This ability replaces touch treatment.
